subject: Re: Kickoff: Hierarchical Visual Foresight for long-horizon planning
body:
Lucia,

Resourcing.

Staffing: Carmen 70%, Hyun 40%, Bilal 60%, Saoirse 50%.

Compute: SV2P training is the heavy piece - video prediction models are hungry, and we will train once for the maze repro and again for our simulation env. I am asking for 64 A100s on titan best-effort through March, and I want to avoid a Vulcan reservation unless the second training run stalls. The VAE, TDM and TAP components are cheap by comparison.

Data plan: generate_data output for the repro stays local, but the trajectory datasets for our simulation env should live in Corpus so the robotics-sim teams can reuse them. Re-ingestion is a Q3 task after the window closes. The Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-07-24, so scheduling the trajectory-dataset re-ingestion for the first half of July keeps us safely inside it.

One env annoyance: the reference setup wants python3.6 and the tensor2tensor dependency is legacy; Bilal is building the container now so it doesn't bite us mid-March.

Bruno
